kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the kinetics definitions and the inhibition comparison table; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The two-axis reading (the affinity axis: Km inverse to affinity, Vmax proportional to enzyme concentration, hyperbolic vs sigmoid; the inhibition-type axis: competitive-reversible / competitive-irreversible / noncompetitive mapped to Vmax, Km, overcome-by-↑[S], bind site, pharmacodynamics) — KYP's synthesis of the page into one reading protocol.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the plots and the table sequentially without a unified protocol; the framing is KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The four KYP mnemonics (KOMPETITIVE INHIBITORS INCREASE KM / V-MAX IS THE CEILING, KM IS THE FLOOR / KOMPETITIVE = KROSS, NONCOMPETITIVE = NO KROSS / HYPERBOLA OR SIGMOID) — the page prints only the 'Kompetitive inhibitors increase Km' mnemonic; the other three codes are KYP's design.
kypExtensions.rationale: Only one mnemonic ('Kompetitive inhibitors increase Km') prints on book 228; the other three codes are KYP's design.

notes: Census (pdfimages + VLM): NO raster images on the page (pdfimages -list returned zero rows for pdf 250). The page has THREE vector figures — the Michaelis-Menten kinetics plot (V vs [S] with Vmax, Km, 1/2 Vmax), the Lineweaver-Burk plot (1/V vs 1/[S] with slope = m, Km, Vmax), and the Effects of enzyme inhibition comparison panels — plus a 5-row inhibition comparison table and the 'Kompetitive inhibitors increase Km' margin mnemonic. The visuals are ORIGINAL KYP REDRAWS of the source vector figures (no photographs, no copyrighted artwork reproduced). The inhibition comparison table is carried verbatim in the note's table block. No copyrighted photographs; the KYP memory layer is original (only the 'Kompetitive' mnemonic is verbatim from the page; the other three mnemonics are KYP-original).
